title: Wildfly: authenticated client could attach a consumer with a selector containing crafted wildcard… (CVE-2026-75880)
description: CVE-2026-75880 is a security vulnerability in Wildfly where an authenticated client can attach a consumer with a specially crafted selector using wildcard characters. This causes excessive evaluation during message delivery attempts, which consumes a shared broker thread and results in a denial of service condition. The issue affects Wildfly versions prior to 42.0.0-r1. A fix is available in version 42.0.0-r1.
